name: bestocr
description: bestOCR for agents: the bestocr-mcp MCP server (evidence-based multi-engine OCR — pipeline: one call from input to a deliverable docx, with never-overwrite and output validation enforced in the binary; ocr with auto routing + fallback chain; consensus with six pluggable adjudicators (ds-lite/majority/ds-full/prior-weighted/irt/rover, selectable via adjudicator param, tradeoffs never ranked); recommend/list_engines/list_models; ocr_status/ocr_result async polling; notarized binary auto-downloaded on install) plus workflow skills (ocr — any PDF/image → Markdown; ocr-to — thin shell over pipeline, math → native OMath via pandoc when available, macdoc otherwise; compare — local vs cloud reference; evidence-ingest — runlog → T2 gate). Document-assembly engines (doc.paddleocr-pipeline, doc.marker) are routed by document class. Recommendations are evidence-labelled, never guesses.
